headline: India's Foreign Exchange Reserves Fall by $4.44 Billion to $700.90 Billion
summary: Data from the Reserve Bank of India showed that the country's foreign exchange reserves declined by $4.44 billion to $700.90 billion, extending a downward trend.
why: Foreign exchange reserves provide a buffer for central banks to manage currency volatility and cover external debt obligations.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: A contraction in foreign exchange reserves reduces the central bank's external shock absorption capacity.
